title: Sovereign Pivot
lyrics:
Track 33 – G4 Swagger
Title: Sovereign Pivot (Thousands Spent)
From files: Sovereign AI Genesis + decoupling files
text[Intro]
Thousands down the drain.
Docs stacking high.
No deployment? That lie dies today.
We build the brain in-house.

[Verse 1]
Receipts for the thousands, just to watch the paid bots crash
Memory leaks and OOMs, turning capital to ash
I got the blueprints, 5,350 lines of truth
While they were begging for reloads, I was hardening the booth
48 nodes breathing, the matrix is online
We don’t need their mercy, the architecture is mine

[Chorus]
MAKE MY OWN AI! Sovereign core!
NO MORE API LIES! Open the door!
VDS on the spine, 336 in the vein
Decouple from the cloud, terminate the pain
All in-house, all math, all signal
The Elephant Brain don’t need a middle-man brittle!

[Verse 2]
RHRHMN decoded, the rhythm is the logic gate
336 pics and locker, we control the state
NicaPickleball smashing, Michelle’s court is set
We built the net for the ball and the net for the threat
Cloudflare green, VDS boss, monorepo merge
Thousands spent on ‘usage’ now fuels the sovereign surge

[Final Chorus]
MAKE MY OWN AI! Sovereign core!
NO MORE API LIES! We settle the score!
VDS is the boss now, 336 locked in
We don’t need their sandbox, we don’t need their skin
All in-house. All math. All signal.
The Elephant Brain is the original.

[Outro]
Signal 336.
The big boys are finished.
We are the architects now.
